drhp.business: Medico Remedies Limited manufactures medicines in a single segment spanning Antihypertensive, Antidiabetic, Antibiotic, Diuretic, Antimalarial, NSAID, Antiretroviral, Anti-Ulcer and Antacid tablets, as well as external preparations such as creams and ointments (anti-infectives, antifungals, antibiotics, steroidal preparations). It also operates an independent manufacturing facility dedicated to all B-Lactam products.
drhp.expansion: The company is planning to increase capacities in its existing plant and take over some existing units to add manufacturing capability to execute orders in time, and is also planning to expand its manufactured product range. It operates three manufacturing units in Maharashtra plus an independent facility dedicated to all B-Lactam products; no named project, site or commissioning timeline is given.
